about: OWN A CAR post queue (framework: marketing/research/x-launch-frameworks.md). tools/xpost.py posts entries whose status is 'approved' once their time passes. Everything starts as 'draft'. Times are ET (UTC-4 until Nov 1, UTC-5 after). Media paths are repo-relative. {placeholders} fill from the live registry at post time. when_keys = hold until that many keys sold; until_keys = skip once that many sold.

I'm selling unlimited keys to one Lamborghini.

replies.about: Ready answers for the first two hours (never auto-posted; paste by hand, rephrase so no two are identical).
replies.Is this a scam?: If we don't reach 6,000, you get all $50 back. If we do, you get a key, a certificate, and your name on a Lamborghini. That's the whole thing.
replies.Is this a security?: No. There's nothing to sell, nothing to earn and nothing to trade. It's a numbered key and your name on a car.
replies.Can I drive it?: No. Nobody can. That's what makes it fair.
replies.Where does the money go?: Every dollar is on the site: $20.45 car, $13 key and box, $8.80 tax, $6 shipping, $1.75 card fees.
replies.What if you don't hit 6,000?: Everyone is refunded in full, automatically. You don't have to ask.
They gave 1,000 people a PT Cruiser and made them race for it. This one is shared.
replies.Why a Lamborghini?: It's the most owned-looking object there is.
replies.Where's the car?: Right now it's a render. At 6,000 keys it's a car, and its address, insurance and schedule go on the site.

ideas.about: Unscheduled post ideas. Promote one into 'posts' (with an id, time and account) to schedule it.
math: Every time someone buys a key, you own a little less of your Lamborghini. You're welcome.
If a million people buy a key, each owns 1.4 grams. That's a paperclip of Lamborghini. We'd frame it.
The Gallardo makes about 560 hp. Split {keys} ways, that's the horsepower of a small, determined pony.
deadpan: The key doesn't start the car. Nothing does, for you.
"Who holds the title?" The project. A DMV title doesn't have room for 6,000 names. The car does.
The car will never be sold for profit. If it ever leaves, it's donated, and owners hear first.
